meta.name: google-ads-landing
meta.description: Score and diagnose Google Ads landing pages. Use when asked to audit a landing page, check landing page quality, diagnose high-CTR but low-conversion-rate ad groups, improve Quality Score's Landing Page Experience component, or compare an ad group's messaging against its landing page. Trigger on "landing page audit", "landing page score", "landing page quality", "why is my conversion rate low", "LPX", "landing page experience", "ad to page match", or when `/google-ads-audit` surfaces a high-CTR / low-CVR ad group.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给落地页体验评分,定位广告转化率低的原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你投放谷歌广告时有点击却转化不佳,想找出落地页拖后腿的地方
copy.tagline_en: Score your Google Ads landing pages and find why clicks aren't converting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Google Ads get clicks but few conversions and you want to fix the landing page.

howto.what: 对指定的落地页做实测评分:抓取页面和 PageSpeed 数据,按 5 个加权维度(信息匹配、加载速度、移动体验、信任元素、表单 CTA)逐项给分,并列出最值得先修的 3 个问题和可能的利润提升。
howto.when: 当要求审计落地页、检查落地页质量或诊断转化率低,或提到“landing page audit”等触发词时;高点击低转化的广告组也会由 /google-ads-audit 自动转接进来。

say.note: Claude 会抓取页面并按五个维度输出评分报告。

say.text: 我的广告点击率高,可转化率很低
say.note: 它会锁定高点击低转化的广告组,检查落地页并给出诊断。

say.text: 对比这个广告组和落地页文案是否贴合
say.note: 它会判断“广告→页面”信息传递是否断裂并给出示例建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scores and diagnoses Google Ads landing pages: it fetches the page plus PageSpeed data, measures five weighted dimensions (message match, speed, mobile, trust, form/CTA), and reports top 3 fixes and estimated monthly profit lift.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to audit a landing page, check landing page quality, or diagnose low conversion rate; also auto-handled for high-CTR / low-CVR ad groups surfaced by /google-ads-audit, or on phrases like “landing page audit”.

say_en.note: Fetch the page and produce a scored report.

say_en.text: My ads have high CTR but conversions are low
say_en.note: Diagnose the related landing page for this high-CTR / low-CVR ad group.

say_en.text: Compare this ad group's copy with its landing page
say_en.note: Check whether the ad-to-page message matches and explain any gap.
